title: Heard: replies that type themselves out word by word. Possible, and here is how

text: A reply in a VS Code tab cannot stream to your page: VS Code keeps those words to itself until the whole message is done. But our dev server can already run a Claude turn by itself, the way the Ask box does, and that kind of turn can hand over every chunk as it is generated. So the fast assistant moves out of the VS Code tab and into the dev bar: you talk or type there, your words show at once, the server runs the assistant on Sonnet at low effort, and each chunk is pushed over the socket and appended to the log as it arrives. The finished reply is saved as a card, and your words still reach my inbox. I am briefing a minion for the streaming pipe now; it plugs into the dev bar's message box when that lands.
